ideas.pitch: An automated CLI tool and triage assistant designed to ingest, parse, and rapidly solve repetitive Jeopardy-style CTF challenge structures.
ideas.problem_statement: Participants will solve more than 50 Jeopardy-style challenges across web security, cryptography, binary exploitation, reverse engineering, digital forensics, OSINT, steganography, networking, and mobile security on the Secureops platform.
ideas.title: SecureOps-CLI Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: By streamlining challenge parsing and automating initial recon steps across all 9 CTF categories, an individual participant can drastically reduce time-per-flag compared to manual execution during the tight 8-hour window.
